jobs.description:

Dansk:

TL Concept er en veletableret produktions- og entreprenørvirksomhed, der er specialiseret i teknisk isolering, pladekapper, ventilationskanaler og brandbeskyttelse. Med mange års erfaring og ca. 600 dygtige medarbejdere, leverer vi løsninger af høj tysk kvalitet til byggeprojekter i hele Europa. TL Concept oplever stærk vækst, og Danmark er et af vores strategiske vækstområder. Vi har etableret et dansk selskab med dansk ledelse. www.tlconcept.eu      

 

Vi er kendt for vores fokus på innovation, præcision og en kundecentreret tilgang. Vores mål er at skabe bæredygtige og effektive løsninger, der lever op til vores kunders krav om kvalitet, samtidig med at vi sikrer et sikkert og inspirerende arbejdsmiljø for vores medarbejdere. Hos TL Concept er vi stolte af vores stærke teamkultur, hvor samarbejde og udvikling er i centrum. Vi tror på, at motiverede medarbejdere skaber de bedste resultater, og derfor prioriterer vi uddannelse og personlig udvikling.

 

Vi søger en engageret Teknisk Isolatør til vores team. Hos os får du mulighed for at lære at arbejde med alle typer teknisk isolering og udvikle dig indenfor området, da vi ikke kun isolerer, men også monterer ventilationskanaler og pladekapper.

 

Som Teknisk Isolatør vil du være medansvarlig for at drive vores projekter fremad. Du vil  være en del af et team på op til 15 isolatører, og din arbejdsdag vil være præget af variation og ansvar. Mulighed for forfremmelse, hvis du gør det godt og beviser dit værd.

VI TILBYDER

·  Et ansvarsfuldt og afvekslende job i en dynamisk virksomhed med vindermentalitet

·  Ansættelse efter dansk lov i dansk datterselskab

·  Fastansættelse på 37 timer/uge

·  Mulighed for faglig udvikling og eventuel videreuddannelse

·  Ægte holdånd, åben kommunikation og uformel arbejdsatmosfære

·  Professionelle processer og korte beslutningsveje

·  Timeløn efter kvalifikationer og gode ansættelsesvilkår iht. Isoleringsoverenskomsten

·  Betaling for evt. overarbejde

 

FAGLIGE OG PERSONLIGE FORUDSÆTNINGER

·  Praktisk og håndværksorienteret og har erfaring med montering af teknisk isolering

·  God fysik og kan arbejde selvstændigt samt i team

·  Ansvarlig og kvalitetsbevidst , loyal, ærlig og vindende personlighed

·  Indstillet på at lære og tage ansvar for egne opgaver

·  Mødestabil og kan stå op om morgenen

·  Villig til at rejse til aktuelle byggeprojekter i Danmark (vi har aktuelt projekter på Sjælland 1 år frem)

·  Taler min. et af følgende sprog: Dansk, norsk, svensk, polsk, engelsk eller tysk

·  Arbejdstilladelse i EU samt kørekort (kategori B)

 

DINE OPGAVER

·  Montering af teknisk isolering af ventilationskanaler, kedler, tanke, rør og diverse andre tekniske installationer

·  Montering af pladekapper og ventilationskanaler

·  Brandsikring af beton- og stålkonstruktioner samt rørgennemføringer

·  Arbejde med både nye installationer og vedligeholdelse af eksisterende anlæg

Send dit fyldestgørende ansøgningsmateriale på dansk engelsk eller tysk per e-mail, inklusive cv, lønforventning og tilgængelighed, til Jørgen Villadsen: jorgen.villadsen@tlconcept.eu

 

For spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte Jørgen per e-mail.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

English:

TL Concept is a well-established manufacturing and contracting company specialising in technical insulation, sheet metal cladding, ventilation ducts and fire protection. With many years of experience and approx. 600 skilled employees, we deliver solutions of high German quality to construction projects throughout Europe. TL Concept is experiencing strong growth, and Denmark is one of our strategic growth areas. We have established a Danish company with Danish management. www.tlconcept.eu 

We are known for our focus on innovation, precision and a customer-centric approach. Our goal is to create sustainable and efficient solutions that fulfil our customers' demands for quality while ensuring a safe and inspiring work environment for our employees. At TL Concept, we are proud of our strong team culture, where collaboration and development take centre stage. We believe that motivated employees create the best results, which is why we prioritise training and personal development.

We are looking for a dedicated Technical Insulator to join our team. With us, you will have the opportunity to learn how to work with all types of technical insulation and develop within the field, as we not only insulate, but also install ventilation ducts and sheet metal jackets. 

As a Technical Insulator, you will be jointly responsible for driving our projects forward. You'll be part of a team of up to 15 insulators and your working day will be characterised by variety and responsibility. Opportunity for promotion if you perform well and prove your worth.

WE OFFER

·   A responsible and varied job in a dynamic company with a winning mentality

·   Employment according to Danish law in a Danish subsidiary

·   Permanent employment of 37 hours/week

·   Opportunities for professional development and possible further training

·   True team spirit, open communication and informal working atmosphere

·   Professional processes and short decision-making processes

·   Hourly wage according to qualifications and favourable terms of employment in accordance with Insulation collective agreement

·   Payment for any overtime work

 

PROFESSIONAL AND PERSONAL PREREQUISITES

·   Practical and craft-orientated, with experience in the installation of technical insulation

·   Physically fit and able to work independently and in a team

·   Responsible and quality-conscious, loyal, honest and winning personality

·   Willing to learn and take responsibility for own tasks

·   Punctual and able to get up in the morning

·   Willing to travel to current construction projects in Denmark (we currently have projects on Zealand 1 year ahead)

·   Speaks min. one of the following languages: Danish, Norwegian, Swedish, Polish, English or German

·   EU work permit and driving licence (category B)

 

YOUR TASKS

·   Installation of technical insulation of ventilation ducts, boilers, tanks, pipes and various other technical installations

·   Installation of sheet metal covers and ventilation ducts

·   Fire protection of concrete and steel structures and pipe penetrations

·   Working with both new installations and maintenance of existing installations

Send your complete application material in Danish, English or German by email, including CV, salary expectations and availability, to Jørgen Villadsen: jorgen.villadsen@tlconcept.eu 

For questions, you are welcome to contact Jørgen by email.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Wenn Sie gute Leistungen erbringen und sich bewähren, besteht die Möglichkeit einer Beförderung.

WIR BIETEN

·   Festanstellung mit 37 Stunden/Woche

·   Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Entwicklung und eventuellen Weiterbildung

·   Echten Teamgeist, offene Kommunikation und informelle Arbeitsatmosphäre

·   Professionelle Prozesse und kurze Entscheidungswege

·   Qualifikationsgerechter Stundenlohn und günstige Arbeitsbedingungen nach dem Isolationstarifvertrag

·   Bezahlung aller Überstunden

 

FACHLICHE UND PERSÖNLICHE VORAUSSETZUNGEN

·   Praktisch und handwerklich orientiert, mit Erfahrung in der Montage von technischen Isolierungen

·   Körperliche Eignung, selbständiges und teamorientiertes Arbeiten

·   Verantwortungsvolle und qualitätsbewusste, loyale, ehrliche und gewinnende Persönlichkeit

·   Bereitschaft zu lernen und Verantwortung für eigene Aufgaben     zu übernehmen

·   Bereitschaft, zu aktuellen Bauprojekten in Dänemark zu reisen (wir haben derzeit Projekte auf Seeland, die 1 Jahr vor uns liegen)

·   Spricht min. eine der folgenden Sprachen: Dänisch, Norwegisch, Schwedisch, Polnisch, Englisch oder Deutsch

·   EU-Arbeitserlaubnis und Führerschein (Kategorie B)

 

IHRE AUFGABEN

·   Montage der technischen Isolierung von Lüftungskanälen, Heizkesseln, Tanks, Rohrleitungen und verschiedenen anderen technischen Anlagen

·   Montage von Blechabdeckungen und Lüftungskanälen

Senden Sie Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen in Dänisch, Englisch oder Deutsch per E-Mail mit Lebenslauf, Gehaltsvorstellungen und Verfügbarkeit an Jørgen Villadsen: jorgen.villadsen@tlconcept.eu

Do you enjoy writing C++ software that interacts directly with hardware and makes complex systems perform reliably in the real world?

At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our work brings together computer vision, embedded software, control, electronics and real-world product development.We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer with strong C++ experience to develop software close to the hardware layer of our drone platform. Experience with motor control and Field-Oriented Control (FOC) is highly preferred.This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of software, electronics and control systems, where performance, reliability and real-world behaviour matter.

The role
You will work on embedded software that supports the control and operation of Robotto’s drone and unmanned systems.Your work will involve developing reliable C++ software that interfaces with hardware, sensors, motors and other system components. You will work closely with colleagues across control, electronics, computer vision and flight testing to take software from development through integration and into real-world operation.For candidates with motor-control experience, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of our motor-control capabilities, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC).

What you will do

• Develop and maintain embedded software in C++ for drones and unmanned systems.
• Build software that interfaces with motors, sensors, actuators and other hardware components.
• Work with real-time and performance-sensitive software.
• Contribute to motor-control software, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC), where relevant to your experience.
• Develop and integrate communication between embedded components and wider product systems.
• Debug complex software and hardware interactions and identify root causes of issues.
• Collaborate closely with control, electronics, flight-test and software engineers.
• Contribute to software architecture, testing, documentation, code quality and technical decisions.
• Support integration and testing on real hardware and drone platforms.

What success could look like in your first 3–6 months

• You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto’s embedded architecture, hardware and control systems.
• You are contributing production-quality C++ code to our embedded platform.
• You are successfully integrating and debugging software on real hardware.
• You are contributing to improved reliability and performance across our embedded systems.
• If you have motor-control experience, you are actively contributing to our FOC and motor-control development.
• You have become a trusted technical partner for colleagues across software, control, electronics and flight testing.

What we are looking for
We are looking for an engineer who is comfortable working close to hardware and enjoys solving complex technical problems where software and physical systems meet.

• At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience, ideally within embedded or real-time systems.
• Experience with motor control, particularly Field-Oriented Control (FOC), is highly preferred. Experience with BLDC/PMSM motors, control loops, PWM, encoders or related motor-control technologies would also be highly relevant.
• Strong C++ programming skills.
• Hands-on experience developing software that interfaces with hardware.
• Experience with embedded systems, real-time systems, microcontrollers or similar low-level environments.
• Good understanding of debugging, testing, software architecture and version control.
• Experience with communication protocols such as CAN, UART, SPI, I²C or similar is an advantage.
• Experience with robotics, drones, autonomous systems or other complex electromechanical products is an advantage.
• Professional fluency in English.
• A degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, robotics, mechatronics or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience is equally welcome.

Who you are
You are practical, curious and comfortable getting close to both the software and the hardware when solving a problem.

• You take ownership of your work and care about software quality and reliability.
• You enjoy understanding how systems behave beyond the code itself.
• You approach debugging methodically and are comfortable solving difficult software/hardware problems.
• You collaborate well across software, electronics and control disciplines.
• You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.
• You communicate technical trade-offs, progress and risks clearly and pragmatically.

Minds and makers forging ahead together.
At Robotto, we value people who do. People who take ownership, are willing to try new things just to see if they work, and are comfortable asking for forgiveness rather than permission. We want people who are curious, proactive and excited about turning ideas into something real.

Our hiring process
Our process is designed to be straightforward, practical and conversational:

1. Introductory conversation with our Talent Acquisition & Recruitment Partner
A chance to learn more about Robotto, the role and what you are looking for, while giving us an opportunity to understand your background and motivation.

2. Meeting with the Hiring Manager / Principal Engineer
A deeper conversation about your technical background, C++ and embedded experience, motor-control experience where relevant, and your approach to solving engineering problems.

3. In-depth Technical Evaluation & Meeting with our COO
A hands-on technical session where you will receive a short assignment to prepare in advance and then work through it together with members of our technical team, similar to a pair-programming exercise. The focus is on understanding your technical approach, problem-solving and how you collaborate.Following the technical evaluation, you will meet with our COO for a conversation about the role, Robotto and mutual fit.

4. Offer
If there is a strong mutual fit, we will move forward with an offer.

Why join Robotto?
Robotto is building advanced autonomy technology for drones and unmanned systems, working at the intersection of software, hardware, computer vision, control and real-world operations.You will join a highly technical and ambitious team at an exciting point in the company’s journey. As we continue to scale our engineering team and work on challenging new projects, you will have the opportunity to influence how our embedded and control software develops.This is a role where your software will not remain behind a screen. You will see it integrated with real hardware, tested on real systems and used in demanding real-world environments.You will work closely with talented engineers, take meaningful technical ownership and help shape the next generation of Robotto’s technology.

Equal Employment Opportunity
Robotto is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience and potential. Please note that certain positions may require specific nationality or eligibility for security clearance in accordance with applicable laws and the nature of our work.

Want to build C++ software that helps power the next generation of autonomous and unmanned systems?At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our technology brings together computer vision, C++ software, autonomy, embedded systems and real-world product development.

We are looking for a C++ Software Engineer to join our engineering team and contribute to the software that connects and powers different parts of Robotto’s technology platform.This is a hands-on software engineering role for someone who enjoys building reliable systems, solving complex technical problems and seeing their software move beyond development into real-world operation.

The role
You will develop and maintain C++ software across Robotto’s software ecosystem, working on applications and services that support the operation, communication and coordination of our unmanned systems.Depending on the project, your work may span different parts of our platform—from software running alongside our autonomous systems to applications used to configure, control and interact with them.You will work closely with engineers across computer vision, autonomy, embedded software, electronics and testing to develop new capabilities, integrate components and continuously improve the reliability and performance of our systems.

What you will do

• Design, develop and maintain high-quality software primarily in C++.
• Build software used across our drone and unmanned-systems platform.
• Develop reliable communication and data flows between different software and hardware components.
• Work on performance-sensitive and potentially real-time or near-real-time applications.
• Integrate software with APIs, networking components, sensors and wider system infrastructure.
• Debug complex issues across interconnected software systems and identify root causes.
• Contribute to software architecture and technical design decisions.
• Write maintainable, testable and well-structured production code.
• Participate in code reviews, testing, documentation and continuous improvement of our engineering practices.
• Collaborate closely with computer vision, embedded, autonomy and hardware engineers.
• Support integration and testing on real systems and drone platforms..

What success could look like in your first 3–6 months

• You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto’s software architecture and how the different parts of our platform work together.
• You are contributing production-quality C++ code to our products.
• You have taken ownership of features or components from development through integration and testing.
• You are successfully debugging and solving issues across interconnected systems.
• You are contributing to improved reliability, maintainability and performance of our software.
• You have become a trusted technical partner within the engineering team.

What we are looking forWe are looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and building software that interacts with real systems.

• Strong professional experience developing production-quality software in C++, with a solid understanding of modern software engineering practices.
• Solid understanding of software architecture, data structures, algorithms and object-oriented design.
• Experience developing multi-component or distributed software systems.
• Experience with networking, inter-process communication, APIs or communication protocols is highly relevant.
• Good understanding of concurrency, multithreading and performance considerations in C++.
• Experience with debugging, testing, version control and modern software development practices.
• Experience with Linux-based development environments is an advantage.
• Experience with robotics, drones, autonomous systems, defence technology or other complex technical products is an advantage, but not a requirement.
• Experience working with software that interfaces with hardware or real-world systems is an advantage.
• Professional fluency in English.
• A degree in computer science, software engineering, robotics or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience is equally welcome.

Please apply even if you don't meet every single point. We are interested in what you can bring to the team, your ability to learn and your motivation to work on the challenges we are solving.

Who you are
Beyond your technical or professional experience, we care about how you work and collaborate.You:

• Are curious and enjoy solving complex problems.
• Take ownership and follow things through.
• Communicate openly about progress, challenges and risks.
• Are comfortable in a growing company where priorities can evolve.
• Enjoy collaborating with people across different disciplines.
• Value testing, learning and continuous improvement.
• Want to contribute rather than simply execute a predefined set of tasks.

Why join Robotto?
Robotto is building advanced autonomy technology for drones and unmanned systems, working at the intersection of software, hardware, computer vision, autonomy and real-world operations.You will be joining Robotto at an exciting stage of our journey as we continue to grow our team, technology and products.

Our teams work across software, computer vision, control, electronics, hardware and real-world testing. This means you will work closely with people from different technical disciplines and see how your work contributes to the wider product.

We are an ambitious and collaborative team, and we value people who take ownership, challenge ideas constructively and want to help build both great technology and a great company.This is not a role where everything is already defined. You will have the opportunity to:

• Work on challenging technology with real-world applications.
• Have meaningful ownership and influence over your area.
• Work closely with talented colleagues across multiple disciplines.
• See your work move from an idea or prototype into real-world use.
• Help shape how we work as the company continues to grow.

Our hiring process
We want our hiring process to be straightforward, transparent and conversational.

1. Introductory conversation with People & Culture
A chance for us to learn more about you and for you to learn more about Robotto, the role and what we are looking for.

2. Meeting with the Hiring Manager
A deeper conversation about your experience, skills and approach to the role

.3. Technical / Role-specific discussion
Depending on the position, this may include a technical discussion, practical exercise, case or live scenario relevant to the work you would be doing at Robotto.

4. Leadership meeting
A conversation with a member of our leadership team to explore mutual fit and give you another opportunity to learn about Robotto and where we are going

.5. Offer
If there is a strong mutual fit, we will move forward with an offer.The exact process may vary slightly depending on the role.

Interested?
If this sounds like an opportunity you would like to explore, we would love to hear from you.Apply through our careers page and tell us a little about yourself, your experience and why Robotto interests you.

Equal opportunity
At Robotto, we want to build a team where different experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.We welcome applications from qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, nationality, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or other characteristics protected by applicable law.

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Analyst with interest in IT and Pension
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy turning complex business requirements into clear, practical software solutions? Join Keylane as a Senior Business Analyst and help shape the pension processes that support people through important life events, from retirement to disability and the loss of a loved one.

Key about your team

You will join Life Events, an area of approximately 70 colleagues working at the heart of Plexus, our pension platform. We are organised into three teams that support pension processes related to retirement, death and disability, as well as premium and benefit calculations. You will be part of Life Events B, a team with 30 colleagues across Denmark, Netherlands and India. Our developers, testers and business analysts work closely together throughout the development process, from planning to delivery. Guided by client needs, we combine business knowledge and technical expertise to deliver a standardised, consistent solution across clients and countries.

Key about your role

As a Senior Business Analyst in the Life Events department, you will work closely with our Product Owner, Development team, and and Delivery to ensure our products continue being the leading solutions. You will analyse and elaborate requirements coming in from our customers via Delivery and help evolve and design a standard solution to support customer’s needs.

You will have responsibility of tasks that include:

• Analysing business requirements for pension processes and translating them into clear development and test tasks.

• Shaping functional solutions and guiding developers throughout implementation within Life Events— Ranging from supporting brand new processes within the system, to help defining the implementation of new calculations.

• Demoing new features and enhancements to stakeholders.

• Supporting in quality assurance, through testing and bug intake.

Requirements

We are looking for someone who enjoys working with complex systems, customers and calculations, and thrives on collaborating across international teams.

Ideally, you have:

• An educational background in pension, math, IT or a related field.

• At least +5 years experience with software projects.

• Experience with or knowledge of the pension industry – this is a strong advantage.

• Experience with SQL or are comfortable working with databases and data analysis is a plus.

• Have a hands-on mindset, take ownership, and are comfortable driving tasks and issues forward.

• Strong numerical and analytical skills, as many of the tasks involve working extensively with data and calculations.

• Experience gathering and breaking down complex requirements into actionable tasks within IT projects.

• Communicate confidently in English.

Using AI

• You have used AI-assisted development tools, such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, GitHub Copilot or Cursor, in your work or your own projects.

*Please submit your application, including your CV. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

If you have any questions, please send an email to manager of the team, martin.bo.heiberg@keylane.com or Talent Acquisition Specialist, Lykke Kæstel Alsgren at lykke.alsgren@keylane.com.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. We operate with a strong focus on product management and lifecycle thinking, where long-lived teams take full ownership- from problem discovery to solution delivery and continuous improvement - ensuring we address real business needs.

• Experience working with SaaS vendors.

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

What we offer

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup

jobs.occupation: IoT Services Manager, Nordics, UK & Benelux
jobs.description:
Trackunit is a fast-growing company and a leading supplier of IoT solutions, operating out of many offices worldwide. Trackunit specializes in digital solutions that connect machines, people, and systems in the global construction industry. The construction industry is the least digitalized industry of all. This lack of digitalization has left construction far behind a global economy on the rise and placed the industry as one of the least productive industries too.

We are looking for an IoT Services Manager to own end-to-end customer-facing project management, and IoT technical account management for their region. You'll be the primary technical point of contact for device, fleet, and IoT solution health to our customer as a trusted technical advisor, guiding them from installation through fleet-health optimization and ongoing device lifecycle support.

With locations in Denmark, The UK and The Netherlands, we offer you a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations or remotely. No relocation assistance is offered for this position.

**What’s in it for you?

**

• A place in an agile growth SaaS business, with possibilities to grow internally in the company. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450 employees.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities. We do this by touching upon your impact on our triple focus: impacting yourself, impacting teams/relations and impacting the organisation/strategy.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We do offer you a flexible setup and believe that you best can structure how your routines look like. And once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring - we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives on our career site.

**Who are you ideally?

**

• Technical account management or technical advisory experience in an IoT, telematics, or hardware environment.

• Comfortable consulting customer and interpreting fleet-health and technical data to advise customers and benchmark performance against peer accounts.

• Working knowledge of device and firmware management (CAN, MODbus, firmware/FOTA, BLE sensors) sufficient to guide configuration, validation, and troubleshooting.

• Experience in customer-facing project management, installation, or deployment operations.

• Strong organizational skills — comfortable working with multiple concurrent programs at once.

• Skilled at building trusted relationships with both customer technical stakeholders and internal sales, account, and support/engineering teams.

• Professional fluency in either one of the Nordics languages or Dutch, besides English.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries - this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're super excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Build trusted customer partnerships: Serve as the primary technical contact for IoT accounts, understand customer goals and document agreed solutions and priorities.

• Present insights and recommendations: Lead monthly fleet and device health reviews, translating technical findings into business impact, recommended actions and measurable outcomes for operational and executive audiences.

• Own technical configuration: Manage CAN/Modbus profiles, firmware—including FOTA—and device operating modes to keep customer fleets healthy and reporting accurately.

• Drive proactive fleet health: Monitor fleet and device health, investigate non-reporting devices, and proactively identify and resolve risks before they affect customer operations.

• Support quality deployments: Partner with deployment and technical teams to align requirements, validate installation quality and establish reliable data from day one.

• Lead technical escalations: Coordinate resolution across Support, Engineering and delivery teams, maintaining clear accountability, customer communication and follow-through.

• Enable adoption and growth: Guide customers on relevant IoT capabilities, partner with Sales and Customer Success on improvement opportunities, and bring customer feedback into product and service discussions.

**Our hiring process

**Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

**The question is: Are you in?

**_Trackunit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

__Trackunit also prioritizes providing reasonable accommodations for qualified people with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let our People & Talents team know.

_**About Trackunit

**Trackunit is the leading operating data platform connecting people, assets, and processes in construction.

A global technology company connecting the construction industry - by orchestrating data and infrastructure - to build the most useful industry for the world.

We connect construction through one platform to create a living, evolving ecosystem that delivers data and insights to the off-highway sector. With more than 2 million assets connected and more than 2 billion data points collected each day, we use technology to eliminate downtime, improve safety, and help customers improve the bottom line in a sustainable, cost-effective way
